Letters.description: A map from single ASCII characters to their Morse code symbol sequences. Keys are automatically uppercased; lowercase keys will not be matched.

additionalProperties.description: A non-empty string composed exclusively of '.' (dot) and '-' (dash/line) characters.

propertyNames.description: A single ASCII character (will be treated as uppercase).

Prosign.description: A prosign: a series of letters without a space between.

code.description: Letters that make up this prosign

maps_to.description: Character this prosign is mapped to
